name: hash_manifest
description: Deterministic per-file hash manifest derived from Phase 2 archive_index outputs.

columns.name: origin_drive
columns.description: Top-level custody bucket from archive index.

columns.name: relpath
columns.description: Repository-independent relative path rooted at archive root.

columns.name: filesize_bytes
columns.description: Exact file byte size from filesystem stat for regular files; 0 for non-hashed statuses.

columns.name: sha256
columns.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 digest for hash_status=ok, else empty string.

columns.name: hash_status
columns.description: Deterministic hashing outcome for each path.

columns.name: error
columns.description: Stable machine-readable error token when hash_status != ok.
